pages.calib.detail.n_discordantes: {n} decision(s) that disagree between the two
pages.calib.detail.perm_p: permutation test: p = {p} (probability that chance does as well)
pages.calib.diag.chauffe: {n} signal(s) dropped while the headset is settling (normal at the start)
pages.calib.diag.perdus: {n} trial(s) lost: the headset signal was not ready
pages.calib.diag.refus: {n} window signal(s) refused: was the window opened for a training?
pages.calib.duree: Estimated time: ≈ {minutes} min for {compte}, headset settling and warm-up included.
pages.calib.mesure.acc_ecca: eCCA accuracy (measured on unseen trials, decoding window)
pages.calib.pas_encore_enregistre: ⚠ Not saved yet: this model is in a temporary folder. "Save model" keeps it, "Redo" throws it away.
pages.calib.sans_son: ⚠ No sound on this machine ({raison}). The session goes on anyway: follow the written cue, without the beeps.
pages.direct.cvep.echelle: correlation scale (max 1) · to win, a target must exceed {corr_min} and lead the 2nd by {marge}; then {min_votes} of the last {vote_len} windows must agree
pages.direct.cvep.echelle_vote_inconnu: correlation scale (max 1) · to win, a target must exceed {corr_min} and lead the 2nd by {marge}; then a vote over the recent windows
pages.direct.errp.artefact: — NO VERDICT: window rejected (artifact: signal much more agitated than at rest)
pages.direct.errp.perdu: — NO VERDICT: EEG signal of this feedback lost
pages.direct.errp.sans_mesure: No measurement on this feedback (EEG lost or rejected): score and threshold do not count here.
pages.direct.errp.sante: windows rejected (artifact): {taux} ({n} out of {vues} feedbacks since the last rest)
pages.direct.errp.score_et_fonctionnemen: score {score} vs threshold {seuil} · imperfect detector: keeps {tnr} of the correct commands, catches {tpr} of the errors (target {vise}). An "error" verdict is a hint, not a certainty.
pages.direct.mi.echelle: probability scale · threshold {seuil} per window, then {min_votes} windows agreeing out of the last {vote_len}
pages.direct.mi.echelle_vote_inconnu: probability scale · threshold {seuil} per window, then a vote over the recent windows
pages.direct.mi.non_conclu: — (vote inconclusive: fewer than {min_votes} of the last {vote_len} windows agree)
pages.direct.mi.non_conclu_vote_inconnu: — (vote inconclusive: not enough recent windows agree)
pages.direct.p300.echelle: mean score per target{sur} · no threshold: the engine takes the target that stands out. The bars compare with each other; this is not an absolute scale.
pages.direct.passif.attente_premier: Waiting for the first decoded sample
pages.direct.passif.avertissement_attent: No decoded output yet: the unit and scale of this mode will show with the first sample.
pages.direct.passif.avertissement_z: Deviation from noise, measured against your rest when the mode started. It cannot be compared between people or between sessions: read it as a trend.
pages.direct.passif.fenetre_rejetee: Window rejected ({raison}): the last valid values stay on screen.
pages.direct.passif.rejets: {n} window(s) rejected since the mode started
pages.direct.ssvep.echelle: z scale (deviation from noise) · threshold {seuil}: a target is chosen when it is above it
pages.electrodes.aide: Each circle is an electrode, the head seen from above, nose at the top. Green: good contact. Red: the electrode picks up mostly noise (its bar goes past the mark) or picks up nothing (flat signal); press it, wet it, then wait a few seconds. Empty circle: no measurement, the headset is disconnected. A blink turns Fz red for a moment: that is normal; an electrode that STAYS red is badly placed. The two small circles behind the ears are the reference: if its pads come off, all channels measure the same thing.
pages.electrodes.reference_decrochee: Reference detached: stick the pads behind the ears back on.
pages.electrodes.repere: Mark: {seuil} µV. Beyond it, the contact is not good.
pages.electrodes.sans_mesure: No measurement: is the headset on and connected?
pages.fenetre.anormale_brutale: ⚠ The {quoi} window stopped abnormally (code {code}, abrupt stop): {sortie}
pages.fenetre.deja_une: ⚠ A window is already running ({quoi}): close it before starting another one. With two windows, the engine would mix the two sessions without any warning.
pages.fenetre.en_cours: {quoi} window running: do not close it by hand during the session.
pages.fenetre.en_cours_libre: {quoi} window running: close it (Esc) when you are done trying.
pages.fenetre.pas_demarre: ⚠ The {quoi} window did not start (executable not found or missing dependency): {sortie}
pages.flux.a_choisir: {n} visible stream(s). Pick one in the list to see what it sends.
pages.flux.aucun_flux: No stream is visible on the network. Start a mode in the grid (tick "published"), then click "Find streams". If nothing appears while a mode is decoding, the problem is the network, not the decoding.
pages.flux.aucun_nomme: No stream named "{nom}" on the network right now.
pages.flux.choisir_avant: First pick a stream in the list above: the engine records the verdicts of one mode only, not the whole network.
pages.flux.disparu: "{nom}" has disappeared from the network ({erreur}). Engine stopped, or mode unpublished? Click "Find streams" again to reopen it.
pages.flux.enregistrement_bulle: Each line is timestamped with the same clock as the stimulus window's log. You can join the two files on column "t" to analyze the session afterwards. Without this file, all that remains is what scrolled past on screen.
pages.flux.enregistrement_interrompu: ⚠ Recording interrupted: {probleme}. {n} verdict(s) saved anyway in {chemin}
pages.flux.enregistrement_quoi: Writes the engine's verdicts to a file, one line per published decision.
pages.flux.enregistrement_termine: Done: {n} verdict(s) in {chemin}. To analyze the session, join this file to the stimulus window's log on column "t".
pages.flux.explication: This page reads the network the way your app does: what is empty here is empty for it too.
pages.flux.explication_bulle: No privileged access to the engine: a Unity, Python or MATLAB client receives exactly what is shown here. Code that reads a stream: the "examples/" folder of the repository (Python, Unity).
pages.flux.ouvert_muet: Open: {nom} ({type}). Nothing received on the last cycle: is this mode started and published?
pages.flux.ouvert_recoit: Open: {nom} ({type}). {n} sample(s) on the last cycle.
pages.flux.ouverture_ratee: "{nom}" could not be opened ({erreur}). Click "Find streams" again.
pages.flux.plus_visible: "{nom}" is no longer visible on the network (mode stopped, or "published" unticked?). Pick a stream in the list.
pages.flux.sans_moteur: No engine (test mode): nothing to record.
pages.mesure.applique: "{label}" = {valeur} {unite} kept for "{mode}". On the "{mode}" page, block "1. Set up", "Suggest" will choose frequencies that avoid your alpha.
pages.mesure.barriere_franchie: GATE PASSED: the session can go on.
pages.mesure.barriere_non_franchie: 🛑 GATE NOT PASSED — STOP HERE. As long as this check fails, no test or decoding makes sense: they all read this same signal. Fix the setup, then run this check again.
pages.mesure.candidat: ⚠ Your new model is not saved yet: this test runs on the model shown below. First click "Save model" (on the "Train" page), then come back to test.
pages.mesure.detail.cible: {hz} Hz: {annonces} call(s) out of {essais} trials, including {justes} correct
pages.mesure.detail.cible_barre: — threshold to reach: correlation ρ = {rho} (background noise: mean μ = {mu}, standard deviation σ = {sigma})
pages.mesure.detail.fenetres_repos: background noise taken from {n} windows at rest
pages.mesure.detail.n_chauffe: {n} dropped (arrived while the headset was settling)
pages.mesure.duree: Duration: ≈ {secondes} s for {compte}, headset settling included.
pages.mesure.frequences_du_mode: Frequencies tested: {valeurs} Hz, the ones from the "{mode}" page (they are changed there).
pages.mesure.origine: The greyed settings come from the "{mode}" page (block "1. Set up"), and this test uses them: change them there.
pages.mesure.precedent: Result from a previous session: it may not describe your current settings. "Begin", below, runs again with these.
pages.mesure.sans_son: ⚠ No sound on this machine ({raison}): the step beeps will not sound. The session goes on anyway: follow the written cue.
pages.mesure.sans_son_yeux_fermes: ⚠ No sound on this machine ({raison}). Part of the session is done with your eyes closed: without a beep, you will not know when to open them. Connect an audio output, or have someone read the screen aloud to you.
pages.traces.defauts_aide: Goes back to the starting display filter (1 Hz high-pass, notch unticked). Only changes the trace.
pages.traces.filtre_aide: Only changes this trace: the stream published on the network and what the modes decode stay unchanged. A high-pass removes the slow drift of the channels; the higher it cuts, the more it distorts a blink (smaller, followed by a rebound). 5–40 Hz is the SSVEP decoding band.
pages.traces.rognees: ⚠ outside the lane, trace cut: {voies}. Much more agitated than the other channels: contact? electrode lifted?
pages.traces.secteur_aide: Removes the hum of the mains electricity ({hz} Hz). Leave it unticked to check contact: a channel that hums clearly more than the others is an electrode badly placed.
